data.title: LlamaRisk Proposes Dynamic Borrowing Caps for Aave V3
data.description: According to ChainCatcher, LlamaRisk proposed introducing dynamic borrowing caps for Aave V3. Chainlink CRE would calculate cap increases to limit the pace of borrowing growth.

data.title: Jim Cramer: Higher Yields Weigh on Stocks as Club Trims TJX, Adds Kimberly-Clark and Constellation Brands
data.description: According to CNBC, Jim Cramer said higher bond yields were weighing on stocks. The Nasdaq fell more than 1% Friday, extending its declines to a second straight session. The club trimmed TJX ahead of next week’s earnings and used the proceeds to add to Kimberly-Clark and Constellation Brands, its newest portfolio position. Cramer called Friday’s drop in Advanced Micro Devices a buying opportunity and said he would start a position in AMD and exit Intel if unrestricted.

data.title: Canada Puts $140 Million Into LNG Project Backed by Indonesia’s Richest Person
data.description: Canada’s government injected C$200 million ($140 million) into a west coast liquefied natural gas project backed by Indonesia’s richest person, according to Bloomberg. Prime Minister Mark Carney is pushing to diversify exports away from the US.

data.title: STOCKS | Barclays Reportedly Plans to Cut About 200 Investment Banking Jobs Starting Next Week After Announcing 5,000 Job Cuts
data.description: Barclays plans to begin another round of layoffs as early as next Tuesday, cutting about 200 jobs in its investment banking division, mainly in New York and London, across seniority levels. According to Sina Finance, people familiar with the matter said the cuts follow the bank’s announcement last month of plans to eliminate about 5,000 positions. One source said the latest reductions are part of Barclays’ annual operational efficiency plan, intended to optimize staffing and direct more resources to priority businesses and talent areas. A Barclays spokesperson declined to comment.

data.title: Amazon’s First North American Logistics Union Contract Set in Canada
data.description: An independent arbitrator imposed terms Friday for a union contract covering about 700 Amazon.com Inc. warehouse employees in western Canada, making them the company’s first North American logistics workers covered by such an agreement, Bloomberg reported, citing a person familiar with the matter. Unifor, one of the nation’s largest private-sector unions, is party to the contract.

data.title: San Francisco Fed President Mary C. Daly: FOMC Must Remain Transparent and Accountable
data.description: According to Jin10, San Francisco Fed President Mary C. Daly said the FOMC must remain transparent and accountable and communicate policy clearly.

data.title: San Francisco Fed President Mary C. Daly: Housing-Excluded Services Inflation Is Not Moving in the Right Direction
data.description: According to Jin10, San Francisco Fed President Mary C. Daly said the Fed is closely monitoring services inflation excluding housing, and that the measure is not currently moving in the right direction.

data.title: Swiss Windward Bio Gains 7.9% in US Debut After $225 Million IPO and Private Placement
data.description: Windward Bio Group AG shares rose 7.9% in their US trading debut after the company raised about $225 million through an initial public offering and private placement, Bloomberg reported.

data.title: AI TRENDS | Fortune: OpenAI Disbands Independent Robotics Team, Reassigns Researchers
data.description: According to Jin10, Fortune reported that OpenAI disbanded its independent robotics research team and reassigned the researchers to other company departments. OpenAI said the move does not mean it is abandoning robotics and that it aims to accelerate robotics development through general AI models.

data.title: West African Oil Costs Some Buyers $64 Less per Barrel
data.description: West African oil just became $64 a barrel cheaper for some buyers, Bloomberg reported.

data.title: AI | Lutnick Faces Scrutiny Over Efforts to Keep Nvidia Chips Out of China
data.description:
US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick faces accusations that his department did too little to keep Nvidia’s prized AI chips out of China after Jensen Huang’s ouster as the company’s CEO, Bloomberg reported.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent blamed Lutnick Friday for failing to blacklist Singapore-based Megaspeed over possible violations.

data.title: SEC Plans to Reduce Executive Pay Disclosures for Public Companies
data.description: The Securities and Exchange Commission plans to overhaul executive compensation disclosures by reducing the information publicly traded companies must provide investors, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: STOCKS | Cisco Earnings Beat Estimates, but Wall Street Remains Cautious on Its Outlook
data.description: Cisco reported results for the first quarter of fiscal 2027 on Thursday, beating market expectations. According to Sina Finance, Barclays analyst Tim Long maintained an Equal Weight rating and a $109 price target on Friday, implying 6.9% upside; he said AI orders from hyperscalers likely fell significantly quarter over quarter in the first fiscal quarter, while noting these orders are intermittent and arrive in batches. Goldman Sachs analyst Mike Ng maintained a Neutral rating in a November 12 report and said Cisco's orders missed expectations. He said the company's raised margin outlook and better-than-expected performance showed strong operating leverage, but the rising share of revenue from hyperscalers could pressure gross margins in the second half of fiscal 2027.

data.title: Virtual Schools’ Billion-Dollar Business Grows Fastest in Texas
data.description: U.S. online public schools are enrolling more students than during the pandemic, with expansion happening fastest in Texas, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Rockstar’s 1,600-Plus UK Employees Weigh Unionization Ahead of Grand Theft Auto VI
data.description: More than 1,600 employees at Rockstar’s UK offices are deciding whether to unionize, Bloomberg reported.

data.title: Joachim Nagel: Another ECB Rate Hike Likely if Current Conditions Persist
data.description: According to Jin10, ECB Governing Council member Joachim Nagel said on Friday that the ECB may need to raise interest rates again if current conditions persist. He said the longer inflation remains elevated, the greater the risk of second-round effects. Compared with the September forecasts, the inflation outlook has worsened: energy prices are significantly higher than previously expected, while natural gas and electricity prices have accelerated in recent weeks. Core inflation remains high, and short-term inflation expectations have risen alongside headline inflation. Nagel said the European economy is showing some resilience and a repeat of the 2022 inflation episode is unlikely, provided the ECB fulfills its responsibilities.

data.title: Dollar Heads for Largest Weekly Rise in More Than a Month on Fed Rate Bets
data.description: The dollar is on track for its strongest weekly advance in more than a month as expectations grow that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates next month, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: FutureBit Apollo III Bitcoin Miner to Launch at Four Micro Center Stores
data.description: According to ChainCatcher citing Bitcoin Magazine, FutureBit’s Apollo III Full Node will go on sale this Friday at four Micro Center locations, marking the Bitcoin mining hardware maker’s first move into physical retail. The stores are in Brooklyn, Miami, Tustin, California, and Austin, Texas. Customers can also reserve the miner online for in-store pickup. FutureBit has not disclosed store inventory or retail pricing.

data.title: Nvidia Contacts Arm CEO Rene Haas in Search for New CEO
data.description: Arm CEO Rene Haas has been approached during Nvidia’s search for a new CEO and is among the potential successors. According to Odaily, it is unclear whether the contact has advanced to formal negotiations.

data.title: Bitwise Curates Three New Jupiter Vaults for Stablecoin Holders to Earn Yield
data.description: According to Odaily, Bitwise’s CEO said on X that Jupiter now offers stablecoin holders opportunities to earn yield through three new vaults curated by Bitwise: the Bitwise JupLend Optimizer Vault, the Bitwise sUSDai Yield Vault, and a third vault for non-U.S. investors.
